Meetings

# Put the recorder on the table. Everyone can see it.
A card-sized recorder for meetings, lectures, and calls. Transcripts and summaries in the TicNote app.

Capture: record meetings on the card or earbuds. Understand: transcription in 120+ languages, summaries and mind maps in the app. Act: ask the recording questions and pull out action items.
See TicNote, Lite, and compare models.Buy TicNote
